content.comment_body: Thank you for your clear response. Is it feasible to connect to multiple slave devices using the same port number? For instance, can I manage around 10 slaves through port 502?
[product_name] supports a total of 16 Modbus connections, with a maximum of 8 connections as a client and 8 connections as a slave.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked whether [product_name] can connect to multiple Modbus slaves using a single port number, specifically port 502. Another user explained the current system limitations: up to 16 Modbus connections are allowed, with a maximum of 8 client connections and 8 slave connections. The focus is on connection scalability and flexibility during Modbus communication.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking to manage several (about 10) Modbus slave devices through a single port using [product_name], and hopes to have more than 8 client connections.
